bugs.error_message: npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false failed in pronunciation review route/tests because buildPronunciationReviewData was called with legacy page-entry arrays, and overlay regression fixtures widened fontFamily to string.

The overlay test helper had no return type, so object literal fontFamily widened beyond the OverlayFont union.

bugs.error_message: Pronunciation generation produced only whole-word audio; breakdown_url was not backfilled for rows that already had full_word_url.
bugs.root_cause: The generation skip logic treated any existing audio URL as complete coverage. Full-word-only rows were skipped by collectMissingTokens/generatePronunciationEntries on subsequent runs, so missing breakdown_url assets were never generated unless force=true.
bugs.fix: Changed skip logic to skip only rows with complete coverage (both full_word_url and breakdown_url). Full-word-only rows are now selected for generation/backfill. Added tests for partial coverage collection and full-word-only backfill.

bugs.error_message: Breakdown pronunciation for words like "caption" pronounced the isolated "tion" chunk incorrectly instead of the /shun/ sound.
bugs.root_cause: The breakdown TTS text used raw orthographic chunks (`cap, tion`). ElevenLabs can read isolated `tion` literally (tee-on) rather than as the suffix phoneme.
bugs.fix: Added buildBreakdownSpeechText with spoken suffix mapping for `tion` -> `shun`, and use it when synthesizing breakdown audio. Added tests asserting caption uses `cap, shun`.

bugs.error_message: Breakdown TTS for words ending in tion synthesized the literal chunk 'tion' instead of the /shun/ sound (e.g. caption => cap, tion).
bugs.root_cause: splitIntoBreakdownChunks correctly produced raw chunks like ['cap', 'tion'], but generation passed chunks.join(', ') directly to TTS, causing isolated 'tion' to be spoken literally.
bugs.fix: Added buildBreakdownSpeechText() to convert spoken-only breakdown chunks from raw chunk text, mapping isolated 'tion' to 'shun', and wired breakdown synthesis to use it. Added tests for caption speech text and generation TTS payload.

bugs.error_message: User noted pronunciation breakdown segments should have a slight pause between segments.
bugs.root_cause: Current breakdown TTS text uses comma-separated chunks (e.g. "cap, shun"), which hints a pause but leaves pause duration up to the TTS model and may not be consistent enough.
bugs.fix: Implemented low-risk option 3: added BREAKDOWN_SEGMENT_SEPARATOR = " ... " and changed buildBreakdownSpeechText to join spoken chunks with that separator, so caption becomes "cap ... shun". Updated tests and verified pronunciationGeneration tests plus TypeScript.
